world.title: Brazil’s Flavio Bolsonaro beats polls in presidential vote, faces Lula in runoff
world.summary: Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro has advanced to a presidential runoff against incumbent President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, according to the country’s electoral authority. The first-round polls showed Bolsonaro narrowly edging out Lula amid rising cost-of-living concerns and ongoing corruption issues. With over 97% of ballots counted, the two candidates will compete for the presidency in the upcoming election.

world.title: ‘Re-deployed to their home stations’: US withdraws all bombers from UK's Fairford base after suspected terror plot
world.summary: The United States has withdrawn all bombers from RAF Fairford in England, a base utilized for operations against Iran. This decision follows an investigation into a suspected terror plot. The US military stated that the bombers are being "re-deployed to their home stations." The withdrawal marks a significant change in the operational presence at the UK base.

world.title: 1 dead as Russian drones hit desi pharma plant in Ukraine
world.summary: Six Russian drones attacked an Indian pharmaceutical plant in Sumy, Ukraine, on Sunday, resulting in one engineer's death. Sanjeev Gupta, cofounder of Kusum Group, characterized the incident as a "targeted attack." The strike caused significant damage to the facility, with smoke billowing from the site. The incident highlights ongoing tensions and conflict in the region.

business.title: D-Street poised for a positive start as GIFT Nifty trades firmly higher
business.summary: The Nifty index has declined for eight consecutive weeks, dropping 3.1% last week amid market pressures. Analysts indicate that foreign selling and rising bond yields are negatively impacting sentiment. Additionally, the Indian rupee's weakening adds to the challenges investors face. The 200-Week EMA is seen as a crucial indicator for potential market recovery or further decline.

business.title: RBI may end rate-cut cycle with first hike since February 2023
business.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is anticipated to conclude its cycle of rate cuts this week, marking its first interest rate hike since February 2023. Bankers and economists predict a 25 basis points increase in the repo rate, ending a period of declining interest rates that commenced in February 2025. The decision will be closely monitored.

business.title: OpenAI's Altman says AI benefits warrant accepting some risks
business.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman stated that the advantages of artificial intelligence warrant accepting certain risks. He emphasized the importance of keeping AI technology broadly accessible to the public. Altman acknowledged that while there may be negative consequences, the overall benefits of AI development and deployment are significant, suggesting a balanced approach to managing potential challenges associated with the technology.

technology.title: Phones Launching in India This Week: Vivo V80, X Fold6, S2 FE, OPPO F35 Series and More
technology.summary: The OPPO F35 series will launch on October 5, followed by the Vivo V80, S2 FE, and X Fold6 on October 6 in India. The Vivo S2 FE features a 10,000mAh battery, starting at Rs 38,999, and supports 44W charging. It is expected to use the MediaTek Dimensity 7300e chipset for performance and enhanced photography capabilities.

technology.title: ChatGPT gets virtual try-on feature: You can now see how clothes look on you before buying
technology.summary: OpenAI has launched a virtual try-on feature in ChatGPT, enabling users to upload selfies or full-body photos to visualize how selected clothing and accessories will appear on them before purchasing. Additionally, a Favorites option allows shoppers to save products for later. This innovation aims to enhance the online shopping experience by integrating artificial intelligence into the process.

technology.title: Apple AirPods Pro 3 Drop to $179 for October Prime Day
technology.summary: Apple's AirPods Pro 3 are currently priced at $179 on Amazon, reflecting a $70 discount from the original $249 list price. This marks the lowest price since June. The promotion coincides with Amazon's upcoming fall Prime Day event and follows a recent software update from Apple. The offer is available for a limited time.

sports.title: Mukesh Kumar joins Akash Deep in selection frame for NZ Tests
sports.summary: Mukesh Kumar has emerged as a contender for the New Zealand Test series following his impressive performance in the Irani Cup. The team management, led by Gautam Gambhir, is reportedly considering both Mukesh Kumar and fellow Bengal pacer Akash Deep for selection. Their names are likely to be recommended for the red-ball segment of the New Zealand tour.

sports.title: Nortje and Ackerman: different paths to the same destination
sports.summary: Anrich Nortjé and Marques Ackerman have taken different routes in their cricket careers. Nortjé has not played a Test in over three years but has participated in 104 matches across various formats. In contrast, Ackerman has played 115 games in South Africa and England but has yet to make his international debut in any format.

sports.title: Barcelona star Joao Cancelo scores another banger for Portugal vs Norway
sports.summary: Barcelona's Joao Cancelo scored a remarkable goal for Portugal in their match against Norway. The effort showcased his skill and contributed to Portugal's performance. Fans and contributors are reminded to engage respectfully, adhering to community guidelines that prohibit trolling and negative interactions with rival supporters. Violations of these rules may result in consequences for those involved.

health.title: 'American Covid' strain increase hospital admissions in England
health.summary: The "American Covid" strain, known as the XFG "Stratus" variant, now accounts for over half of sequenced cases in England, leading to increased hospital admissions. Health authorities are urging vulnerable populations to seek autumn booster vaccinations. The rise in hospitalizations is reported by the UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA), highlighting ongoing concerns regarding the variant's impact on public health.

health.title: Improve Your Mood Naturally: Study Says This Popular Nut Can Impact Brain And Boost Serotonin
health.summary: A new study published in the journal Food & Function suggests that daily walnut consumption may enhance mood and influence serotonin levels. Walnuts, known for their omega-3 fatty acids, fiber, and plant compounds, contribute to overall nutritional benefits. This research highlights the growing interest in the connection between diet, gut health, and brain function, emphasizing walnuts' potential impact.

health.title: Endometriosis affects 1 in 7 women: Symptoms, infertility risks and treatment explained
health.summary: Endometriosis affects approximately 1 in 7 women, leading to chronic pain, infertility, and potential career disruption. It can impact various organs, including ovaries and fallopian tubes. Experts emphasize the importance of early diagnosis and specialized care to manage symptoms effectively. Increased awareness and timely treatment are crucial for improving outcomes for those affected by this condition.

science.title: ‘Debris in space threaten space missions, life on Earth’
science.summary: Space debris from defunct satellites and rocket fragments is increasing, posing risks to space missions and services on Earth. The report titled "The Dirty Sky" highlights the urgent need for global regulations to address this growing problem. Experts warn that without intervention, the accumulation of space junk could lead to significant hazards for both space activities and life on Earth.

science.title: ISS Welcomes Crew-13 as Crew-12 Prepares for Journey Home
science.summary: NASA and SpaceX successfully completed a crew rotation at the International Space Station (ISS), with Crew-13 arriving after the fastest launch-to-docking by a U.S. spacecraft in ISS history. As Crew-12 prepares for their return journey, the transition marks a significant moment in space exploration, highlighting the ongoing collaboration between NASA and private aerospace companies.

science.title: Florida researchers shaded corals during the 2024 heatwave; two Caribbean species regained colour while unshaded corals kept paling
science.summary: During the 2024 heatwave, Florida researchers tested shade structures on coral reefs to combat heat stress. The study found that two Caribbean coral species regained their color under shaded conditions, while unshaded corals continued to pale. This experiment highlights the potential of shading as a strategy to protect coral reefs from the adverse effects of rising water temperatures.
